Question Choices: Multiplying by i rotates a complex number by what angle counterclockwise?
Hints: i has modulus 1 and argument pi/2.|Multiplication adds arguments.
Solution: Multiplication by a fixed nonzero complex number multiplies every modulus by its modulus and rotates by its argument, modulo a full turn. The origin stays fixed. Multiplying by i rotates by pi/2 (90 degrees).
